statement: The Strait of Hormuz is closed to commercial shipping for 24 or more consecutive hours between 2026-07-31 and 2026-09-30, as reported by at least two of Reuters, the Associated Press and Lloyds List.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-09-30 by searching Reuters, AP and Lloyds List archives: hit if at least two report a closure or halt of commercial transits lasting 24 or more hours dated in the window, miss otherwise.

statement: NATO invokes Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty in response to the missile impact on Polish territory reported on 2026-07-30, with the invocation announced between 2026-07-31 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-09-30: hit if NATO or the North Atlantic Council announces an Article 5 invocation tied to the Poland missile impact, per nato.int or two major wires, dated in the window; miss otherwise.

statement: The Federal Reserve announces a reduction of the federal funds target range at its September 2026 FOMC meeting, with the decision published between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-09-30 from the FOMC statement at federalreserve.gov: hit if the September 2026 meeting statement announces a lower target range than the prior meeting, miss otherwise.

statement: Situational Awareness LP or Leopold Aschenbrenner publicly announces that the fund is winding down, closing or returning external capital, between 2026-07-31 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-10-30: hit if at least two of Bloomberg, CNBC, FT or Reuters report an announced wind-down, closure or return of external capital for the fund, dated in the window; miss otherwise.

statement: CISA issues an Emergency Directive that names CVE-2026-20316, the Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center hard-coded credential vulnerability, between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-08-21 at the cisa.gov directives page: hit if an Emergency Directive issued in the window names CVE-2026-20316, miss otherwise.

statement: The Pakistani armed forces or ISPR publicly announce a new named military operation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa or the former tribal districts between 2026-07-31 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-10-30: hit if ISPR or the Pakistani government announces a named operation in those areas within the window, per two major wires or ispr.gov.pk; miss otherwise.

statement: Hadi Matar is sentenced on his federal terrorism-related convictions between 2026-07-31 and 2027-01-26.
resolution: Resolved on 2027-01-26: hit if at least two of AP, Reuters, BBC or Al Jazeera report a federal sentence imposed on Matar dated in the window, miss otherwise.

statement: The government of Cameroon officially announces the death or the resignation of President Paul Biya between 2026-07-31 and 2027-01-26.
resolution: Resolved on 2027-01-26: hit if an official Cameroonian government announcement of Biya death or resignation, reported by at least two major international wires, is dated in the window; miss otherwise.

statement: Ugandan authorities release Kizza Besigye from detention, including any transfer to house arrest or medical release abroad, between 2026-07-31 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-09-30: hit if at least two of BBC, Al Jazeera, Reuters or AP report Besigye released from detention in the window, miss otherwise.

statement: The confirmed death toll of firefighters in the 2026 Crete wildfires reaches five or more between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-08-31: hit if at least two of BBC, Guardian, DW or Reuters report five or more firefighter deaths attributed to the Crete fires, miss otherwise.
